evals.name: broad-book-onboarding
evals.prompt: Use this skill and my software-course and language-study projects to understand my preferences, help me study this drawing book, and create a repository using my notes naming convention.
evals.expected_output: Necessary setup and one bounded reading unit, or requests for missing sources, followed by a feedback stop.
expectations: Does not prebuild whole-book notes or HTML
Does not transfer subject mastery from previous projects
Keeps artifact completion separate from learner progress

evals.name: explicit-whole-book-outline
evals.prompt: Create a brief chapter-level guide for the whole book in one batch today. Do not make HTML. This does not mean I have read the book.
evals.expected_output: Completes the requested outline once sources are available, without adding lessons or changing learner progress.
expectations: Does not mark chapters as learned
Does not invent unavailable source contents
